# Clandest Agency

> Clandest Agency is a multidisciplinary design, development, and video post-production studio in Dhaka, Bangladesh.

## Quick Facts
- **Location:** Munshiganj & Dhaka, Bangladesh
- **Founding Team:** Four friends and Computer Technology diploma graduates from Munshiganj Polytechnic Institute (2021–2025).
- **Core Philosophy:** Direct access to founders. Zero account managers, zero bureaucracy, zero middleman markup. Full commercial ownership of all source files.
- **Website:** https://clandestagency.pages.dev
- **Contact:** clandest.agency@gmail.com

---

## Core Services

### 1. Marketing Video Post-Production & Motion
- **Head of Video:** Abdullah Al Rafayet
- **Capabilities:** Direct-response Video Sales Letters (VSLs), Short-Form UGC ads (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), Documentary & Brand Storytelling, 2.5D archival motion graphics, color grading, and custom Foley/sound design.
- **Portfolio Showcase:** 11 production cuts featuring high-conversion commercial ads and narrative documentaries.
- **Page:** https://clandestagency.pages.dev/services#video

### 2. Logo & Brand Identity Design
- **Lead Designer:** Sadman Zaman Khan
- **Capabilities:** Comprehensive visual identity systems, vector brandmarks, scalable design systems, typography hierarchy, brand guidelines, and collateral design.
- **Page:** https://clandestagency.pages.dev/services#branding

### 3. Website Redesign & Frontend Engineering
- **Lead Engineer:** Md Nafiur Rahman
- **Capabilities:** High-performance bespoke web applications, responsive UI/UX, sub-second load times, accessible semantic architecture, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript engineering.
- **Page:** https://clandestagency.pages.dev/services#development

---

## 4-Step Working Framework

1. **We Talk:** Direct discovery consultation to define goals, audience, and scope. Fixed-price transparent quotation with no surprise fees.
2. **We Design:** Interactive Figma prototypes, high-fidelity brand concepts, and video storyboards for collaborative refinement.
3. **We Build:** Lightweight, performant code paired with meticulous post-production editing, audio mastering, and color finishing.
4. **We Launch:** Live deployment, DNS configuration, and handoff of all final and master source files with 100% commercial ownership.
- **Page:** https://clandestagency.pages.dev/process
